name: Window frame

Title crossfade alphas sum to 1 for the whole 0.3 s; afterwards only the new title at alpha 1
Entrance 0.4 s outCubic with an 80 px rise; exit from closerAt-0.1 to closerAt+0.3 (exact endpoints)
validateWindow fails a window above y 560, wider than the frame, or reaching y 1580
